description: This Java class, FlexibleLocation, provides mechanisms for resolving location strings into URL objects, supporting multiple protocols and custom resolvers. It manages a registry of location resolver implementations, loads additional resolvers from properties, and offers utility methods for handling location strings.

classes.name: FlexibleLocation
classes.description: A utility class for resolving location strings into URL objects with support for custom resolvers and various protocols.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string to a URL using appropriate resolver based on location type.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Overloaded method that accepts a ClassLoader for resolving classpath locations.

methods.name: getLocationType
methods.description: Extracts the location type (protocol) from the location string.

methods.name: stripLocationType
methods.description: Removes the location type prefix from a location string.
